metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the Richard rehearsal, the prose line before dinner, the book put into Garnish's hands, and the one line in the account book.

yesterday: The three cues stand as Friday left them. The rehearsal was Richard.
The last line is in. You kept the plain refusal.
Rosaline keeps Berowne. Katharine keeps Dumaine. Garnish has the book, forty-odd leaves, clean.
Heminges wrote "Navarre ended this day." The license is Friday. The fee is seven shillings of the company's.
Tomorrow is the first free morning in six weeks. Titus is at two, and you are in it.
